a5: No. Spamlock can’t stop a company from being hacked, and it can’t change your accounts or settings for you. It finds what has leaked or needs attention, and guides you with simple steps you take yourself.
a6: Spamlock looks for new breaches in Have I Been Pwned’s list every day. When a new breach appears, it checks the emails you saved and tells you if one of them is in it.
a2: From Have I Been Pwned, a public list of data breaches. Two-step sign-in options come from 2fa.directory, and link checks also use Google’s list of dangerous sites.

a3: Your email isn’t in any breach Have I Been Pwned knows about. New breaches are added often, so you can check again from time to time.
